panels.title: Daily heating check — selected local period

options.content: **Device-reported VD accounting, calculated period values — not whole-system metering.** VD means compressor-related device accounting; pumps, fans, controls, standby and NHZ electricity are not verified. A value may cover only the continuous observed prefix shown on its card. Missing/stale data and gaps are unavailable, never zero. Use the native time picker for a day or calendar month; no unsupported annual comparisons. panels.description: Calculated device VD counter differences, kWh per COMPLETE local day. Heating and hot-water purposes stay separate. DST days use actual local boundaries, not 24-hour assumptions. Current/partial selected days and missing/stale/reset days are omitted, never zero; select up to 31 elapsed days. Today’s observed energy is on the cards above. Outdoor conditions are adjacent context, not weather normalization or causal proof.

panels.title: Equivalent MTD · VD electricity

BOTH windows require complete valid history, otherwise unavailable. Main requested headlines are not shortened. Not an annual comparison or daily-ratio average. options.content:
**Notes are optional.** With Grafana annotation-write permission, Ctrl/Cmd-click a timeseries (or drag a time range) → Add annotation. Record a setting or comfort observation and optional `settings` / `comfort` tags; do not copy private notes into tickets or screenshots. Toggle “Settings & comfort notes” to hide/show. Native notes belong to this dashboard; offline notes are equally acceptable. No control commands or annotation service.

Compare consumption with outdoor conditions and room/water targets, not consumption alone. A colder or shorter period is not evidence of a setting effect. Use equivalent elapsed calendar periods only; missing history cannot support annual comparisons. Daily bars show only complete local days (current/partial days are absent, not zero). For the comparison cards, select This month or a month-start-to-date interval: both windows use the shorter equivalent elapsed duration and require complete valid history. Non-month selections or missing prior history are unavailable. The main headlines retain your whole selection. No supported annual comparison is claimed.
